title: Shark Tank Product Review: Cheesecake & Co.👱🏻‍♀️Mom VS. Daughter!👩🏻 Part-4 #sharktankindia #ytshorts
description:
Shark’s FAV reviewed by Mommy Shark! So we’ve reviewed Shark Tank season 2’s food product from Cheesecake & Co. 

SO MANY REQUESTS for Part-4 Shark Tank products reviewed by Mom & me! This video took quite a while to ideate and edit because we wanted to create some fresh content for you guys! Hope you guys liked it ❤️🫶

We’ve reviewed Cheesecake & Co.'s Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake slice which had a rich, creamy texture. I wished the biscoff spread layer was thicker and the price was cheaper. Rs. 300 is a little costly for the cheesecake which is why we deducted a few points in rating.

Hope you enjoyed part 4!
